newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Peters says NZ dollar clearly overvalued.
newsitem.headline: Peters says NZ dollar clearly overvalued.

text.p: New Zealand First leader Winston Peters said on Tuesday the New Zealand dollar was clearly overvalued.
"The dollar is obviously too high for our exporters," he told a news conference. It was impossible to have an export-led recovery with the currency at its present level.

Peters noted that contrary to many commentators' views before New Zealand's inconclusive election on Saturday, the dollar had not collapsed in response to the strong showing of his party. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 4734 746
